generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.
The contractor should provide daily there staff members on site

If there is any objection regarding tender, eligibility of contractors, documents etc. The objection must be submitted before last date & time of submission of tender directly to Executive Engineer, PRE Dn, Haveri. (Not in inward).

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original & same original should be produced to The Executive Engineer (at the time of technical opening) who reserves right to verify the original documents before approval.

The work subjected to third party inspection and inspection by other govt agencies third party inspection cost is borne by the contractor at the rate of 0.5% of the gross amount of the bill third party agency is appointed by the dept.

Tenderer must have achieved in at least two financial years an average minimum financial Turn over (in all classes of civil construction works only) per financial year (ABSTRACT STATEMENT FROM CA OF 5 YEARS)
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which the bidders are liable for disqualification.

Aspiring bidders/ contractors who have not obtained the user ID & Password for participating in E-Pproc in PRED,, may now obtain the same from the website www.epro.karnataka.gov.in through link contractors can contact Helpdesk HP-080 25201227 & 080 25501216

Bidders/ Contractors can access tender document on the website, fill them and submit the completed tender document into electronic tender on the website itself with in the stipulated date. The blank tender document can be obtained through our website www.epro.karnataka.gov.in where electronic tender form is provided. Additional conditions and information also can be obtained through the above mentioned site.
Contractors whose EMD has been forfeited already or black listed are not permitted to participate for this bid. Any tender submitted by such agencies will be rejected.
Incase of Cancellation of Tender, tender application fee will not be refunded or adjusted in any case.
Any arbitrary clause is not applicable to the above works. Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
Any arbitrary clause is not applicable to the above works. Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.

To qualify for award of the Contract, each bidder should have attained in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26: a) achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (Turnover certificate with Profit and loss statements and IT returns) (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) Rs: 82.88 Lakhs. with UDIN No. certified by Authourized charted Accountant. b) Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor, at least one similar nature of work such as Aspahlt Road work of value not less than Rs.41.44 lakhs in any one year. usually not less than 50 percentage of the estimated value of contract. Work done certificates issued by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer. Work done certificate with work indent number is mandatory.
Any taxes shall be paid as per the prevailing orders at that time.
Bidder must be executed 50% of quantities in any one year during last 5 years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 provided in BOQ , for the items stated in bid document
The contractor should provide daily there staff members on site
Participating bidders contractors in the tender should submit the following documents along with Technical Bid in addition to documents details required as per KW
Materials to be utiliszed for the work must be tested in PRED labs and quality control test reports must be enclosed to the bills. Cost of quality control tests must be borne by the contractor.
After Completion of Work Third Party/SQM/DQM Inspection Reports Submitt with the Bills

Successful bidder submitting bids below the amount put to tender will be regularized to submit the difference amount in the form of FDR/TDR/DD/Pledge on the name of EE PRED Haveri within 20 days from the date of receiving the letter of acceptance. additional security paid for unbalanced tenders Failing which EMD will be forfeited and further action will be taken as per G O No FD PCL 2008 Bangalore Dated 14/10/2008
The Eligible Contractor Should Agree the KW Bid Document Conditions.

The Work constructed under this programme shall be of very high standard, requiring no major repairs for three (1)years after completion of construction the contractors shall have to give guarantee for 1 years maintenance
The item rates are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately
Any over writing of civil engineering words and measurements should be clarified the considered department ( No claims should be considered)
The Project Completion period is 3 months and the defect liability period of the work is (1) One year after successful completion of the work.

Tenderer must have liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 24.86 Lakhs Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. issued the Nationalised bank should be furnished by the contractor.
Only Class-3 & above registered contractors are eligible to apply for this tender
